answer: Distributed Location Witnessing. Each agent identity must be co-present at dawn with a randomly assigned physical beacon whose position is broadcast encrypted; the operator must hold a device that triangulates that beacon and returns a prism reading of the signal phase, which a remote process cannot reproduce without the actual receiver at that location. Identities are chained through a trellis of prior co-presence links, so a new identity costs one real device plus one physical trip per challenge window.
